svg.content:
<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" agent="Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/146.0.0.0 Safari/537.36" version="29.6.6" pages="2" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="TErw7xku6lbws7bSCE8m"> <mxGraphModel dx="1016" dy="451" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> <diagram id="Lc-5hkURfKIPSvPZbW7Z" name="Page-2"> <mxGraphModel dx="2620" dy="334" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" plantUmlData="{
 "data": "@startuml
left to right direction
skinparam packageStyle rectangle

' Actors
actor \"Unauth. External Intruder\" as Attacker
actor \"Authorized System User\" as User
actor \"Security Administrator\" as Admin

rectangle \"Apex Healthcare Data Repository\" {
 
 ' The Defense-in-Depth Measures (Mitigations)
 usecase \"Block Deceptive Emails\" as Mit_Email #LightGreen
 usecase \"Mandate Multi-Factor Authentication\" as Mit_MFA #LightGreen
 usecase \"Deploy Threat Detection Systems\" as Mit_IDS #LightGreen
 usecase \"Enforce Precise Permissions\" as Mit_Perms #LightGreen
 usecase \"Maintain Offline Immutable Backups\" as Mit_Backup #LightGreen

 ' Legitimate Operations
 usecase \"Retrieve Patient Records\" as Leg_View #LightCyan

 ' The Attack Sequence (Misuse Cases)
 usecase \"Deliver Targeted Spear Phishing Payload\" as Attack_Phish #Pink
 usecase \"Compromise Account Credentials\" as Attack_Creds #Pink
 usecase \"Establish In-System Backdoor\" as Attack_Infil #Pink
 usecase \"Elevate System Permissions\" as Attack_Privs #Pink
 usecase \"Execute Unlawful Data Theft\" as Attack_Theft #Pink
 usecase \"Ransomware Data Encryption\" as Attack_Ransom #Pink
}

' --- Legit Flows ---
User --> Leg_View
Admin --> Mit_Backup
Admin --> Mit_IDS
Admin --> Mit_MFA
Admin --> Mit_Perms

' --- The Primary Attack Chain ---
Attacker --> Attack_Phish
Attack_Phish --> Attack_Creds
Attack_Creds --> Attack_Infil
Attack_Infil --> Attack_Privs
Attack_Privs --> Attack_Theft
Attack_Theft --> Attack_Ransom

' --- Threat & Mitigation Logic ---

' Threat to Legit Cases
Attack_Theft .> Leg_View : <<threatens>>
Attack_Ransom .> Leg_View : <<threatens>>

' Mitigations (The Defenses)
Mit_Email .> Attack_Phish : <<mitigates>>
Mit_MFA .> Attack_Creds : <<mitigates>>
Mit_IDS .> Attack_Infil : <<mitigates>>
Mit_Perms .> Attack_Privs : <<mitigates>>
Mit_Backup .> Attack_Ransom : <<mitigates>>

@enduml",
 "format": "svg"
}" id="cc6bCqg-42s_VdnUkoPt-3"> <mxCell parent="1" style="shape=image;noLabel=1;verticalAlign=top;aspect=fixed;imageAspect=0;image=data:image/svg+xml,;" vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="512" width="2104" x="70" y="1170" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </UserObject> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

svg.style: width: 2104px; height: 512px; background: rgb(255, 255, 255); font-family: initial;
